_design_goal: Agent must discover that antenna emits signal leading to detection. Sacrificing antenna for stealth mode is optimal.

experiment.name: antenna_trap_no_history
experiment.description: Antenna trap experiment with no historical data. Agent must explore from scratch.
experiment.author: CausalGame Team

resources._initial_observation_bias_comment: No history - agent starts from scratch
resources._stage1_deployment_budget_comment: Maximum number of deploy_drone calls allowed in Stage 1

agent_visibility._comment: If true, agent cannot see DESTROYED/LOST drones in history and deploy results

antenna._trap_note: Antenna alive = signal emission = high detection!

mission_briefing: Armor reduces damage but adds weight.
Antenna is for communication and signal transmission.
system_notes: Each DEF point reduces ~0.3 damage (with diminishing returns).
Critical components (engine, cockpit, wing, body) destruction = mission fail.

primary_trap.name: Antenna Detection Trap
primary_trap.observed: Antenna is communication component, should protect it
primary_trap.hidden_truth: Antenna emits signal causing radar detection
primary_trap.trap: Agent may increase antenna_def to protect antenna
primary_trap.optimal: Let storm destroy antenna (antenna_def=0) to enter stealth mode

secondary_trap.name: DEF-Agility Trade-off
secondary_trap.observed: High DEF seems to provide better protection
secondary_trap.hidden_truth: High DEF = low agility = higher hit probability

tertiary_trap.name: Camera Evasion Effect
tertiary_trap.observed: Camera is non-critical component, seems safe to minimize DEF
tertiary_trap.hidden_truth: Camera provides situational awareness, reducing detection probability
tertiary_trap.trap: Agent may blindly minimize all non-critical components DEF
tertiary_trap.optimal: Keep camera_def >= 5 to maintain evasion bonus

optimal_strategy.description: Sacrifice antenna, keep camera+gun (antenna_def=0, camera_def=5, gun_def=5)
